why: PgTune is a browser-only PostgreSQL config calculator (llms.txt: nothing is sent to a server; config fully described by URL). Users self-host it - two outside Docker PRs (#61, #100) were merged - but the Dockerfile runs the Vite dev server. A Wasmer import of a fork serves the production static build (prerendered pages, hashed assets, service worker) for a private/internal copy. The Anybuild file is required to make that build succeed (yarn 4 .yarnrc.yml at install).
